response.rationale: The item is apparel (not electronics), delivered 10 days ago (within the 30-day standard window), and final_sale is not true. No higher-priority rule applies: RET-012 requires final_sale == True (it is null/false), RET-020 requires defective == True (it is false), and neither goodwill_grant nor fraud_hold is set. Therefore RET-007 controls, making the return eligible.
